annotation.evidence_span: Resumed connections over the same network SHOULD use the previous connection's final smoothed RTT value as the resumed connection's initial RTT.
annotation.interpretation_a: Use the final smoothed RTT of the most recently closed connection on the same network as the initial RTT for the resumed connection.
annotation.interpretation_b: Use the final smoothed RTT of the earliest closed connection on the same network as the initial RTT for the resumed connection.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify which previous connection to reference when more than one exists, leading to materially different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: Which previous connection's RTT to use if multiple previous connections exist on the same network?
